eventDetail.scope: The IEEE PES Innovative Smart Grid Technologies (ISGT) Asia conference focuses on cutting-edge research, development, and deployment of smart grid technologies across the Asia-Pacific region. It provides a platform for academia, industry, and policymakers to exchange knowledge on advanced power systems, digitalization, and sustainable energy solutions.  Key topics include, but are not limited to, smart grid planning and operation, renewable energy integration, distributed energy resources, power electronics and control, grid resilience and reliability, energy storage systems, electric vehicles, and AI/IoT applications in power and energy systems. The conference also emphasizes policy, market design, and regulatory frameworks supporting the transition toward low-carbon and intelligent energy systems.
